what: NIH R01-equivalent grants, average size (total cost, direct + indirect), FY2024
quote: "ReportName":"R01-Equivalent Grants: Average Size" … ["Year","Current Dollars","Constant Dollars (1998)"] … [2024,606393,277302]
note: NIH Data Book report 158 (human page https://report.nih.gov/nihdatabook/report/158; the page is a JS app, figures read from its JSON API). Data Book 'lastUpdated: January 2026'. Nominal FY dollars; price_year = federal FY2024. Average over all funded R01-equivalents in the FY (competing + non-competing). The Extramural Nexus FY2025 post gives FY2024 = $606,438 (small revision). That it is TOTAL cost is supported by Lauer et al. 2023 (entry nih_r01eq_mean_total_fy2021_lauer), whose FY2021 mean total cost matches the Data Book FY2021 value ($571,561).
